text.p: Immunomedics Inc said Wednesday that it has licensed technology from Repligen Corp for the production of LymphoCide, a humanized LL2 antibody product currently in Phase I/II clinical trials for non-Hodgkin's B-cell lymphoma therapy.
The licensed technology relates to the enhanced production of recombinant proteins in mammalian cells, which is the basis of manufacture for Immunomedics' humanized lymphoma antibody.
In a press release, the company said it paid Repligen an upfront licensing fee and will pay royalties on the worldwide sales of LymphoCide, if and when the product receives regulatory approval.
Immunomedics said it is currently in a clinical evaluation of the safety and efficacy of its humanized lymphoma antibody.
